SpeciesEvaluation class

Source: R/species_evaluation.R
SpeciesEvaluation.Rd

Internal class. Evaluates the performance of a model across different species: computes statistics, generates comparisons, and produces reports for each species. Instantiated internally by evaluate.

Details

The class uses a backend for parallel processing and a workspace to access simulation and observation data. It provides methods to run evaluations, summarize results, and export findings.

Active bindings

success

A logical value indicating whether the species evaluation was successful. The evaluation is considered successful if all species comparisons were performed and there are no critical variables identified in any of the comparisons.

SpeciesEvaluation$new()

Create a new SpeciesEvaluation object.

Usage

SpeciesEvaluation$new(
  eval_workspace = NULL,
  species = NULL,
  usms = NULL,
  var2exclude = NULL,
  percentage = 5,
  output_dir = NULL,
  parallel = FALSE,
  cores = NA,
  workspace = NULL,
  backend = NULL,
  logger = default_logger
)

Arguments

eval_workspace

Path to the evaluation workspace. Only used to build a default workspace when one isn't supplied.

species

Optional character vector of species to evaluate.

usms

Optional character vector of USMs to evaluate.

var2exclude

Optional character vector of variables to exclude.

percentage

Threshold (%) above which a variable is flagged as deteriorated vs. the reference.

output_dir

Output directory for CSV/plot exports.

parallel, cores

Parallel execution options. Only used to build a default backend when one isn't supplied.

workspace

An optional EvalWorkspace object. If not provided, a new EvalWorkspace will be created from eval_workspace.

backend

An optional ParallelBackend object for parallel processing. If not provided, a new ParallelBackend will be created from parallel/cores.

logger

An optional logger object for logging messages. If not provided, the default logger will be used.

SpeciesEvaluation$get_species_stats()

Return the CroPlotR statistics already computed by run() for a given species, so that other evaluation classes (e.g. USMEvaluation) can reuse them instead of recomputing the same summary statistics from scratch.

Usage

SpeciesEvaluation$get_species_stats(species)

Arguments

species

The species to get statistics for.

Returns

A list with elements stats (species-level summary, all_situations = TRUE) and stats_usm (per-USM summary with RMSE, rRMSE and n_obs). Elements are NULL if run() has not been called yet or produced no result for this species.

SpeciesEvaluation$run()

Run the species evaluation. This method performs the species evaluation by generating statistics and comparisons for each species based on the provided configuration and workspace.

SpeciesEvaluation$export()

Export the species evaluation results to CSV files and plots. This method exports the statistics, rRMSE comparisons, and deteriorated USM data to CSV files in the specified output directory. It also generates plots for each species and saves them in the "plots" subdirectory.
